metadata.selection: maximum validation exact boards, then macro recall, then lower unweighted loss; earlier tie
metadata.loss: cross entropy with inverse class frequency from training only

initialization.optimizer: new AdamW; previous optimizer state is not inherited

tests.command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_phone_inference.py tests/test_neural.py tests/test_phone_training_dataset.py tests/test_phone_squares.py tests/test_phone_geometry.py -q

overlapAudit.sourceIdentityLimit: Photo source independence is user-reported; unknown sources cannot be independently excluded.

phone.scope: Classification of verified crops only; no automatic detection or final evaluation.
phone.latencyScope: 64 squares including preprocessing; warm models; excludes file I/O and rectification.
phone.memoryScope: Comparison process including both models, imports, indexes and records; not model-only.

digital.scope: Classification of verified crops only; no automatic detection or final evaluation.
digital.latencyScope: 64 squares including preprocessing; warm models; excludes file I/O and rectification.
digital.memoryScope: Comparison process including both models, imports, indexes and records; not model-only.

recommendation: Keep the digital candidate as default. Use phone-v1 explicitly for photo experiments with verified/manual corners. Do not infer photographic detection or general compatibility from crop classification. The modest improvement does not justify replacing the digital model.
nextStep: Inspect remaining photo style errors and plan training-only photographic coverage plus audited digital replay before seeking a shared replacement. Automatic perspective detection remains separate.
